missed_texts.text: i keep circling the same idea
do you know if its occupied?
the morning show is oddly useful
i can meet after the session
the chickens woke me before dawn
i can lend you hand warmers
im heading to the er bay
meet me near the spa entrance
no rush ill work around you
your message made my exhausted heart bloom
the permit is on my clipboard
the work is done im leaving it there
long shift but spirits are up
i thought sam owned that task
i wish memories could stop arriving
you are not too old to hear no
my plans are better when they include you
handover was longer than the shift
im sending all my warmth to you
youre the dream i get to hold
no one laughs at my silly stories now
i need ideas for dads present
